claude.note: Claude Code headless mode. Prompt goes on stdin. {output} = json (quiet) or stream-json (live agent activity in the terminal). Role tools -> --allowedTools; charter forbiddenPaths/forbiddenTools -> --disallowedTools. CLAUDE.md @imports profile.md + lessons.md, so the harness does not inject those twice (except in worktrees).
claude.modelsNote: CLI aliases, never pinned versions: Claude Code resolves haiku / sonnet / opus to the newest release of each family. The controller picks the tier per job (see docs/MULTI-MODEL-SETUP.md).

antigravity.note: UNVERIFIED. Checked with 'agy --help' (1.5.0): '-p' is an alias for '--print' and needs a prompt value; '-p ""' with the prompt on stdin FAILS ('error: empty prompt'), so the prompt is passed as an argument. A full run with the argument form has not been completed yet. Windows limit: a command line is at most 32,767 characters (8,191 through cmd.exe, which .cmd shims use), so a very long prompt passed as an argument can fail; multi-line prompts also depend on Windows argument quoting. agy.exe may be installed in ~/.gemini/bin without being on PATH: add that folder to PATH or doctor reports it as not installed. No auto-approve flag on purpose (agy has --dangerously-skip-permissions and --mode; the owner approved auto-approve for Gemini only).
antigravity.modelsNote: agy --help documents '--model' and '--effort (low|medium|high|xhigh|max)'; 'agy models' lists the models. No alias set: no --model flag is passed, so agy uses its own default on every tier.

gemini.note: UNVERIFIED. Checked with 'gemini --help' (0.68.0): '-p' is appended to stdin; '--approval-mode yolo' auto-approves every tool (the owner approved this for this project); '--skip-trust' is needed in a folder the CLI does not already trust, otherwise approval mode is overridden and it exits with code 55. A full headless run has not been completed yet: the CLI must be logged in with an account tier that it still supports.
gemini.modelsNote: No alias set: no --model flag is passed, so the CLI uses its own newest default model on every tier. To save quota on the fast tier, set models.fast to an ALIAS that `gemini --help` documents (not a pinned version).
